column1: # The legacy diacritics in VedaBase's text, and the Unicode letters they stand for.
# VedaBase's fonts (Balaram, ScaGoudy, ScaTimes and their families) draw these
# Sanskrit letters in place of ordinary Latin-1 ones, so text copied out of Folio
# holds the Latin-1 letter (left) where the reader saw the Sanskrit one (right).
# Checked against the fonts the installers download: Balaram builds most of these
# glyphs from parts (ñ is s + dot, ï is n + tilde), and all 31 match what the
# fonts draw, except that at È the SCA fonts draw ü (docs/how-it-works.md).
# One character becomes one, except û: l plus U+0310 COMBINING CANDRABINDU.
# UTF-8, tab-separated; lines starting with # are comments. Read by
